hero.title: How does your website
hero.subtitle: Get an instant scan of your website's accessibility, SEO, content quality, and performance. See what's holding you back — in plain language, not developer jargon.
hero.subnote: Takes about 15 seconds. We scan your homepage and show you the results instantly.

features.heading: What you'll discover
features.subheading: Our scanner checks the things that matter most for your business's online presence.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Can all visitors use your site? We check for screen reader support, color contrast, keyboard navigation, and more.

content.title: Content Quality
content.description: Is your message clear? We analyze readability, heading structure, and whether your calls-to-action actually work.

seo.title: SEO Basics
seo.description: Can Google find you? We check meta tags, heading hierarchy, image descriptions, and other ranking factors.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Is your site fast enough? Slow pages lose visitors. We measure load time and flag optimization opportunities.

step1.title: Enter your URL
step1.description: Just paste your website address. No account needed, no strings attached.

step2.title: Get your score
step2.description: In about 15 seconds, see your overall score and top issues — explained in plain language.

step3.title: Get the full report
step3.description: Enter your email to receive a detailed report with page-by-page analysis and fix recommendations.

bottomCta.heading: Ready to see how your site stacks up?
bottomCta.subheading: It's free, takes 15 seconds, and could reveal issues you've never noticed.

scanResults.adashiContext: Adashi builds performance and automation systems for growing businesses. This audit identifies the issues that cost you visitors, conversions, and credibility — and shows what's worth fixing first.

scanFailedNotice.heading: We couldn't fully scan this website
scanFailedNotice.body: Our scanner wasn't able to load {domain}. This usually happens with very heavy websites, sites that block automated tools, or pages that require a login. The scores below reflect what we could measure before the error occurred.
